description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification class in the application core of the eShopOnWeb project. It verifies that the specification correctly retrieves orders with their associated order items for a specific buyer.

classes.name: CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification behavior.

methods.name: ReturnsOrderWithOrderedItem
methods.description: Test to ensure the specification returns an order with the correct order items and item details.

methods.name: ReturnsAllOrderWithAllOrderedItem
methods.description: Test to verify the specification returns all matching orders with their respective order items.

methods.name: GetTestCollection
methods.description: Helper method to create a test collection of orders with order items for testing purposes.
